Title: Relates to the creation of a state-wide catalog for preapproved, construction-ready housing plans
Summary: Directs the department of state to create a state-wide catalog for preapproved, construction-ready housing plans; creates a housing infrastructure fund for infrastructure and housing assistance for certain municipalities certified as NEST communities; directs a study to be completed concerning the modification and establishment of minimum prescriptive requirements necessary to include three-family, four-family and six-family dwellings within the scope of the residential code of New York state.
LawCode: Add §94-e, Exec L; amd §10-c, Hway L; add §99-uu, St Fin L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the executive law, the highway law and the state finance law, in relation to the creation of a state-wide catalog for preapproved, construction-ready housing plans; and directing a study to be completed concerning minimum prescriptive requirements necessary to include certain multi-family dwellings within the scope of the residential code of New York state
